## Open

### T-068 — A data module inside the s3 test layer makes the loader log an error

> _2026-09-10 · test/blong-int-adapter · open_

`test/blong-int-adapter/s3/test/fixtures/object.ts` is a plain data module sitting inside the
`test/` layer, so the loader logs
`Error loading ... probably a generic source code was put in a handler group folder`. It is benign,
because the module is imported directly by the CRUD test, and it pre-dates the restructure, but
moving it out of the layer would silence the warning.

### T-802 — A retention-capped topic of 12 partitions is provisioned for the test

> _2026-11-24 · test/blong-int-adapter · open_

Planned in [#307](https://github.com/feasibleone/blong/issues/307).

A setup step that creates `blong.perf.telemetry` through `{ns}.topic.create` — 12 partitions,
`retention.ms` short enough to bound disk, `cleanup.policy=delete` — and skips with a clear message
when the cluster is not reachable, the way the other backends in that package do. The topic is left
for retention to sweep rather than deleted: the CI cluster is disposable and a failed run's messages
are worth more than the bytes.

- verify: the group creates the topic once, is idempotent on a second run, and the topic's metadata
  shows 12 partitions.

### T-803 — The producer and consumer paths are measured end to end

> _2026-11-24 · test/blong-int-adapter · open_

Planned in [#307](https://github.com/feasibleone/blong/issues/307).

Produce a large number of small keyed messages (the shape of a telemetry delta: ~200–400 bytes)
through the adapter's `message.send` and `topic.watch`, timestamping each; consume from the assigned
offset and compute throughput (msg/s) and p95/p99 latency from send to receipt. Six sessions are
interleaved so the key filter is exercised, and the consumer must not join a group.

- verify: `CI=1 blong ./index.ts integration kafka` prints the measured numbers and passes.

### T-804 — The thresholds are recorded and asserted

> _2026-11-24 · test/blong-int-adapter · open_

Planned in [#307](https://github.com/feasibleone/blong/issues/307).

`plans/agent-session-ui/performance.md` documents the cluster, the message shape, the method and the
accepted numbers; the test reads them (from the file or a constant beside it) and fails above them,
printing the measurement so a regression is visible in the log rather than inferred.

- verify: the numbers in the report match the assertion; a deliberately slowed consumer fails the
  test in a scratch run.

## Done

### T-667 — The MinIO integration test in the harness

> _2026-11-14 · test/blong-int-adapter · done_

Planned in [#261](https://github.com/feasibleone/blong/issues/261).

A group under `test/blong-int-adapter/s3/test/test/` — `testBlobStorageS3`, beside `testS3ObjectPut`
and `testS3ObjectCrud` — wiring the blob realm's S3 backend into the suite's `adapter/storage.ts`
and exercising put, get, head, a range, a remove and a cleanup against the MinIO the harness starts
on `30009` (README table, `integration-test.sh`). The package is the place a real backend is tested,
so the realm keeps no env-gated group of its own and its tests stay runnable on a laptop.

- verify: `cd test/blong-int-adapter && blong-dev test` runs the new group green with the backend
  up.

test/blong-int-adapter/blob/ is a new harness area (BLONG_ENV=adapter.blob, MinIO, blob.test.ts
entry, listed in ALL_ADAPTERS and the README): the blob realm's child carries store:false + its
s3Store block, and blob/test/test/testBlobStorageS3.ts drives upload (prepare/write/commit), a full
read, the record via blob.blob.get, a remove that counts bytes, the not-found after it and a temp
sweep - 6 assertions green against the dev MinIO. It is a realm of its own rather than a group
inside s3/ because both the raw adapter and the store answer namespace storage (D-849), and two
ports claiming every storage.blob.* call made the one without the group answer them as unknown
object operations. A Range is not asserted here: a cross-realm dispatch does not carry a fabricated
$meta.httpRequest, so the range is proven in blob/blobServe.test.ts and the streaming-route group
instead.
